name: codex-powertoys
description: Inspect and safely manage Codex skills, plugins, agents, and MCP configuration.

scripts.install:local: pnpm run build && pnpm run package:cli && pnpm run package:vscode && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process'); const dir='apps/vscode'; const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.vsix')).sort((a,b)=>b.localeCompare(a, undefined, {numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base'})); if(!files.length) process.exit(1); cp.execSync('code --install-extension ' + path.join(dir, files[0]) + ' --force', {stdio:'inherit'});" && echo Restart VS Code
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @codex-powertoys/core build && pnpm --filter @codex-powertoys/cli build && pnpm --filter codex-powertoys-vscode build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @codex-powertoys/core test && pnpm --filter @codex-powertoys/cli test && pnpm --filter codex-powertoys-vscode test
